method: Exposure-normalized historical damage rate per circuit (damage records / asset count on that circuit), smoothed with Poisson-Gamma empirical-Bayes shrinkage toward the system-wide rate (method-of-moments fit). Never a calibrated outage probability — a relative historical rate used only to rank circuits Low/Moderate/High.
storm_multiplier_note: Storm setting scales the historical rate as a stated assumption (calm x0.6, moderate x1.0, severe x1.6) — not derived from data; this sample has only one storm event to observe.
